verdict.rationale: A government digital-administration portal could plausibly publish a developer API, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a JavaScript shell behind an account and a Cloudflare-challenged ministry site. Nothing documents published endpoints, a key-issuance path, or stated rate limits.

support.subject: As a developer, the service documents a public API for its data — published endpoints, a key-issuance path, and stated rate limits on its own pages
